channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: AWS Certificate Manager now supports ACME issuance through AWS PrivateLink
item.description: AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) now supports AWS PrivateLink for ACME public certificate issuance, allowing you to request and renew public TLS certificates over a private network path that stays within the AWS network. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Bidirectional Type Slicing
item.description: Abstract: Development tools report what type an expression has, but not why it has that type. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: GLM 5.3 by Z.ai is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Amazon Bedrock now supports GLM 5.3 from Z.ai, giving you a powerful new option for agentic coding and long-horizon software engineering work. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Cloudflare Introduces CLI for AI Agents, Sunsetting Wrangler
item.description: Cloudflare recently launched the open beta of cf, a new open-source, agent-focused command-line interface for interacting with Cloudflare services through a unified CLI. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon Redshift adds support for creating and refreshing Apache Iceberg materialized views
item.description: Amazon Redshift now supports the creation and refresh of Apache Iceberg materialized views. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS IAM Identity Center now supports network access controls for Identity Store
item.description: AWS IAM Identity Center helps you configure the single sign-on experience for your workforce to AWS accounts and applications. IAM Identity Center now supports network access controls for Identity Store, which stores your users and groups. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Control Tower AFT now supports plan-only customization runs
item.description: AWS Control Tower Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) now supports plan-only customization runs, giving administrators the ability to preview Terraform changes before applying them across their managed accounts. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Continuum for Penetration Testing now supports continuous penetration testing integrated directly into your CI/CD pipeline
item.description: AWS Continuum for Penetration Testing now integrates continuous penetration testing directly into your CI/CD pipeline (public preview) AWS Continuum for Penetration Testing (formerly AWS Security Agent) already provides continuous,… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Cloudflare Fixes Cross-Tenant Data Exposure in Containers
item.description: Cloudflare has disclosed a cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability in Containers and Sandboxes, caused by thin-provisioned storage pools configured to skip zeroing reused blocks. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Cloudflare Plans Public Certificate Authority to Issue Quantum-Safe TLS Certificates
item.description: Cloudflare will operate a free public Certificate Authority to issue quantum-safe Transport Layer Security certificates. This initiative addresses challenges in migrating from classical public key cryptography to post-quantum methods. (1 source: infoq)
